label: Card fill *How solid the card's background is. Zen draws 100%; lower lets the window background show through, like glass. Cards sit on the window background, so there is nothing behind them to blur.*
Space gradient strength *The space's own colour gradient on its card. 1 is Zen's; 0 hides it.*
Glass rim *A thin highlight around the card, Glassflow's rim colours when Glassflow is installed.*
Glass sheen *A soft light-to-shade gradient over the card, Glassflow's sheen when Glassflow is installed.*
Card width *Zen uses 242px. Wider cards show longer tab titles.*
Space between cards *Between neighbouring space cards.*
Space name size *The space name at the top of each card.*
